ops.title: package-install fails minutes after a release because uv serves a stale cached index page for capt-hook
ops.description:
Observed 2026-10-13 00:36 PDT deploying 12.93.3. `capt-hook helper install` exited 1 in three seconds, 3.5 minutes after the wheel upload (07:32:39Z): 'uv tool install capt-hook==12.93.3 ... there is no version of capt-hook==12.93.3'. The host was not touched, which is the right failure, but the documented wait ('up to 10 minutes while the package index catches up') did not run and waiting did not help: for ten more minutes `uv pip install --dry-run -v capt-hook==12.93.3` logged 'Found fresh response for: https://pypi.org/simple/capt-hook/' and found no such version, while a direct fetch of that URL listed 12.93.3. One `uv pip install --dry-run --refresh-package capt-hook` rewrote the cache entry and the second install succeeded. uv 0.13.0, no uv.toml, no UV_ environment.

Code: awaitProductRelease (internal/hookd/toolrelease.go:21) returns nil without probing when installedPython() succeeds, so the --refresh-package probe in awaitResolvable may not have run; confirm which branch 12.93.3 took. installProductToolEnv (internal/hookd/manager.go:1024) resolves the tool descriptor through daemonkit's artifact store, whose `uv tool install` passes no refresh for the product package.

Receipts: /tmp/ram-pressure-refresh-20261012-2335/warm-delivery-helper-install.log and warm-delivery-helper-install-2.log.

ops.text: When the index lists the build, package-install installs the tool env without a manual cache refresh, whatever uv has cached for the product's index page
When the index does not list the build yet, package-install waits up to its documented bound instead of failing on the first resolve
A test covers a stale cached index page for the product package
